segments.text: Hello everyone, today I will introduce our judgement free speaking mentor.
Many people feel nervous when they have to speak in front of others, especially when they think they are being judged.
Our project uses Meta Aria glasses to observe speech delivery signals and provide private feedback after practice.
The glasses can help us understand when the speaker's hands move outside the field of view.
We also use PPG signals to find parts of the speech where the speaker may have felt tense.
The goal is not to criticize the speaker, but to show clear improvement opportunities.
In future work, we want the mentor to give more personalized suggestions.
Thank you for listening, and I am happy to answer your questions.
